summary: Bumps the actions/cache GitHub Action from the v5 commit SHA to the v6.1.0 commit SHA in the built-package test workflow.

pr_summary.headline: Bumps the actions/cache GitHub Action from the v5 commit SHA to the v6.1.0 commit SHA in the built-package test workflow.

walkthrough.text: The single changed line at .github/workflows/test-built-package.yml:97 replaces the v5 pinned SHA (caa296126883cff596d87d8935842f9db880ef25) with the v6.1.0 pinned SHA (55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9), preserving the inline version comment.
The cache step inputs (path, key, restore-keys) are unchanged, so the cache hit/miss behavior for the uv dependency cache is unaffected.

All other actions referenced in this workflow (actions/checkout, step-security/harden-runner) and across the rest of the repo are already at their current SHA-pinned major versions, confirming this PR applies the one remaining cache action update.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: Nothing blocks the merge: the change is a single-line SHA swap for actions/cache, the new SHA is properly pinned to an immutable commit with an accurate version comment, the step inputs are unchanged, and the action is only used in this one workflow file.
